title: About Chengdu 80
description: An 80-hour fintech challenge since 2018: mission, people and academic–industry collaboration.
descriptionZh: 自2018年起的80小时金融科技挑战：赛事使命、人物与产学合作。

title: Partnerships & Initiatives
description: Meet Chengdu 80’s academic collaborators and visiting speakers through their profiles and event photographs, alongside the organizations and initiatives behind the competition.
descriptionZh: 通过人物介绍与现场照片，认识成都八零的学术伙伴与交流嘉宾，了解赛事背后的合作机构与倡议。

title: Photos and Videos
description: Chengdu 80 photographs, talks and event films, plus news, historical rules and publications.
descriptionZh: 成都八零照片、嘉宾分享、赛事视频，以及新闻、历届规则与专刊。

title: News
description: Competition stories, international academic exchange, project initiatives and media features from Chengdu 80.
descriptionZh: 成都八零赛事动态、国际学术交流、项目合作与媒体报道。

title: 2024 Chengdu 80: Redefining auto insurance
description: University teams explored insurance for intelligent driving at the seventh Chengdu 80, culminating in the final pitches and awards on 30 October.
descriptionZh: 第七届赛事聚焦智能驾驶时代的汽车保险，高校团队于10月30日展开路演与答辩，迎来评选与颁奖。

title: Chengdu 80 Incubator launches at the 2024 final
zh: 成都八零孵化器在2024决赛现场启动
description: Universities, industry and public-sector organizations launched an initiative focused on fintech projects and talent development.
descriptionZh: 高校、企业与公共部门共同参与，围绕金融科技项目成长与人才培养启动新的合作倡议。

title: Inside Chengdu 80: The Discoverer feature
zh: 走进成都八零：《发现者》专题
description: Shared by FIC, The Discoverer looks behind the scenes of Chengdu 80 through team preparation, collaboration and project showcases.
descriptionZh: 由FIC分享的《发现者》专题，带观众走进团队备赛、协作与项目展示，了解成都八零的台前幕后。

title: 2023 Chengdu 80: Eight teams analyse financial news
zh: 2023成都八零：八支队伍分析财经新闻
description: The sixth edition reached its 2 November final after an 80-hour challenge focused on financial-news analysis.
descriptionZh: 第六届赛事于11月2日举行决赛，八支队伍完成了聚焦财经新闻分析的80小时挑战。

title: Lars Peter Hansen at the 2019 International FinTech Forum
zh: 诺奖学者汉森参加2019国际金融科技论坛
description: The Nobel laureate joined international researchers and practitioners in Chengdu for a forum held alongside the second Chengdu 80.
descriptionZh: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主汉森与国际学者、行业人士相聚成都，参与与第二届成都八零同期举行的论坛。

title: Robert Anderson: Scenes from the 2019 FinTech Forum
zh: Robert Anderson：2019国际金融科技论坛现场
description: Revisit Robert Anderson’s welcome remarks for CDAR and the academic exchanges at the 2019 forum in Chengdu.
descriptionZh: 回看Robert Anderson代表CDAR致欢迎辞的现场，以及2019年论坛在成都展开的学术交流。
